notes: Schedule D line 8a (h) over LT gain-or-loss successor scalars (ADR-0057/0058). v1 remains historical gain-only. v3 extends the guard: besides the long-term covered family (f1099b.covered-lt), the rule publishes only when the basis (f1099b.covered-lt-basis) and proceeds (f1099b.covered-lt-proceeds) sets it subtracts are closed at the current horizon. Why: collect reads closure only when its set is empty; with any member recorded it sums what is present and never asks whether the set is complete, so v2 published a partial line 8a gain when a family had a recorded amount and an unanswered or stale closure. With the guard, an unclosed family blocks this rule SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED, naming the first unclosed set in the order listed, and every line that reads it waits. A complete return (every family closed at the current horizon, or closed empty) publishes exactly what v2 did. Residual, not closed here: a closure attested true over an amount that was never recorded still publishes the smaller sum, because the engine cannot tell a blank from 'nothing'.
